data.sub: Uttarakhand me 10 IAS aur 20 PCS officers ke hue badle.

chat.say: Sir itna transfer dekh kar chakkar aa gaya!
Tum bhi apna transfer chahte ho kya?

data.asar: Officers badle hain, par aapki file fir bhi late hi aayegi.
data.caption:
Uttarakhand mein administrative badlaav! 🏛️

• 10 IAS officers ke huye transfer
• 20 PCS officers ki nayi tayati

Transfer ki speed dekh kar humara dimag hil gaya! 🤯 Apne us dost ko tag karo jo sarkari naukri ki tayari kar raha hai.
